outlined.description: Styles the timerangepicker as an outlined text field. (labels or placeholders required)

labels.description: A text caption or description for the timerangepicker, which use the start and end input's `placeholder` attribute instead.

placeholders.description: The placeholder attribute of the start and end <input>.

disabled.description: Styles the timerangepicker as a disabled text field.

config.description: Flatpickr configuration. Default includes enableTime: true, noCalendar: true, dateFormat: 'H:i', time_24hr: true.

disableRangePlugin.description: Disables the flatpickr rangePlugin and use two <ui-datepicker> instead.
